scope: Synthetic upright raster OCR feasibility, not PDF/AX/browser acceptance

oracle.text: All case-folded Unicode words must match the independent fixture text; ignore only punctuation and whitespace
oracle.boxes: Every recognized nonempty word has a positive-area box within the input image
oracle.confidence: Return finite per-word confidence in [0, 100]; record without an invented quality cutoff
oracle.missing_model: Explicit failure, never an empty success
